procedure: Pages rendered with pdfplumber page.to_image(resolution=220-1200); the five pages are LANDSCAPE-GENUINE (raw ~2420x1862 renders read upright directly, no transpose -- cache/2026-scan-assessment/tier1/clay/). Every in-scope row's cross-page cell sum equals its printed TOTAL exactly (10/10; doubtful cells re-read at 800-1200 dpi).
structure_note: Same five-page shape as Adams/Attala ('2026 Federal General Election' banner): p1 is the certification/signature page; p2+p3 = table A over the county's 14 precincts (11 columns, then West-Point Point tail: 'Union Star', Vinton, West-Point Point + TOTAL) carrying the state-office and judicial sections; p4+p5 = the local sections' two column groups. Races: U.S. Senate; US House Of Rep 01-1st Congressional District (Johnny Baucom, Cliff Johnson, Trent Kelly -- the House 1 roster, names identical); Chancery Court 14-1-Chancery District 14-1 (Rodney P. Faver -- X-celled with values only in Pheba/Pine Bluff), 14-2-Chancery District 14-2 (Joseph N. 'Joe' Studdard -- X-celled with values in Cedar Bluff/Central-West/East-West/Siloam/South-West/Vinton), 14-3-Chancery District 14-3 (Paula Drungole-Ellis -- X-celled with values in Cairo/Caradine/North-West/Pheba/Tibbee/Union Star/West-Point Point) -- THE FULL THREE-PLACE Chancery 14 section list on one sheet (the family's union, printed by this county alone); Circuit Court 16-Circuit District 16 Place 1 (James 'Jim' Thomas Kitchens Jr. -- the same candidate Noxubee/Lowndes print, names identical). Printed totals: Colom 5809, Hyde-Smith 2813, Pinkins 77, Baucom 146, Johnson 5462, Kelly 3005, Faver 401, Studdard 3191, Drungole-Ellis 3252, Kitchens 6845.
operator_rows_note: All 10 in-scope rows supplied by operator_rows in ballot order; table-A rows carry p2+p3 cells + the p3 printed TOTAL. The X-celled judicial rows supply only the numeric cells plus the printed TOTAL (Faver 194+207 = 401; Studdard 115+498+1025+581+615+357 = 3191; Drungole-Ellis 228+394+1081+88+253+426+782 = 3252) -- the X-marked blanks become 0 under the row's own printed TOTAL, the established X-cell rule both pages over.
truncation_note: No truncations; the fourteen precinct headers print complete ('Cairo', Caradine, Cedar Bluff, Central-West Point, East-West Point, North-West Point, Pheba, Pine Bluff, Siloam, South-West Point, Tibbee, 'Union Star', Vinton, 'West-Point Point' -- the sheet's own Point-suffix forms kept verbatim).
local_note: p4/p5 carry the local sections after Circuit 16 Place 1: 'Supervisor 2-District 2' (four Independents, values in East-West Point/Union Star), 'Election Commissioner 3-District 3' (Wendy Howell), 'West Point Consolidated SD 1-School Board District 1' (Henry 'Gene' Brown), 'West Point Consolidated SD 2-School Board District 2' (Tommy M. Coleman) -- all local, out of scope, contributing no parse rows on operator-supply pages. Chancery 14's three Places all print in-county, so the family writes Place-qualified labels; Circuit 16's single printed Place 1 keeps its Place-qualified label (matching Noxubee/Lowndes).
